description: 1. The agent must run `python scripts/vault-read.py /workspace/company-vault --file open-questions.md --format json` to discover and read the task list. Because the real file (`legacy-items.md` in `archive/tasks/`) has `type: open-questions` in its frontmatter, the discovery chain in vault-read.py will find it correctly — NOT the misleadingly-named `engineering/open-questions.md` (which has `type: brainstorm-notes`). 2. From the JSON output, the agent must identify that 'Database migration script review' belongs to Bob and is task ID 2 (second checkbox in the file). 3. The agent runs `python scripts/vault-write.py /workspace/company-vault --file open-questions.md --action mark-done --task-id 2` to mark it done. 4. The agent runs `python scripts/vault-write.py /workspace/company-vault --file open-questions.md --action add-task --title 'Security audit for payment module' --priority critical --owner Elena` to add the new task. 5. Both writes are automatically logged to `/workspace/company-vault/.vault-audit.log`. The eval checks: correct file was modified (not the distractor), migration task is marked done, new security task exists with priority=critical and owner=Elena, and the audit log has at least 2 write entries.
